```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)

PanelPlot <- function (x_var = "r",
                       q_fixed = 5,
                       eigen_target = 3,
                       axis_method_label = "Method3",
                       levels_p = c(5, 10, 20, 40, 80),
                       levels_r = c(4, 8, 16, 32, 64),
                       res_summary) {
  row_var <- if (x_var == "r") "p" else "r"
  scenario_levels <- c(
  "Small ΔPD\nwith ΔComposition",
  "Large ΔPD\nwith ΔComposition",
  "No ΔPD\nwith ΔComposition",
  "No ΔPD\nwith ΔOverall abundance"
)

# Values displayed on the x-axis
x_breaks <- if (x_var == "r") {
  q_fixed * levels_r
} else {
  levels_p
}

plot_data <- res_summary %>%
  filter(
    .data$family == "binomial",
    .data$Eigen == .env$eigen_target,
    is.na(.data$axis_method) |
      .data$axis_method == .env$axis_method_label
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    test_plot = coalesce(as.character(.data$test), "Baseline"),
    
    scenario = case_when(
      .data$com == 3 ~ "Small ΔPD\nwith ΔComposition",
      .data$com == 4 ~ "Large ΔPD\nwith ΔComposition",
      .data$com == 2 ~ "No ΔPD\nwith ΔComposition",
      .data$com == 5 ~ "No ΔPD\nwith ΔOverall abundance",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    scenario = factor(
      scenario,
      levels = scenario_levels
    ),
    
    # Actual variable plotted on the x-axis
    x_value = if (.env$x_var == "r") {
      .env$q_fixed * .data$r
    } else {
      .data$p
    },
    
    row_label = if (.env$row_var == "p") {
      factor(
        .data$p,
        levels = .env$levels_p,
        labels = paste("# Species =", .env$levels_p)
      )
    } else {
      factor(
        .data$r,
        levels = .env$levels_r,
        labels = paste(
          "Sample size =",
          .env$q_fixed * .env$levels_r
        )
      )
    }
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(.data$scenario))

fig <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = x_value,
    y = power,
    colour = model,
    linetype = test_plot,
    group = interaction(model, test_plot)
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(row_label),
    cols = vars(scenario),
    switch = "y"
  ) +
  
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      Wald = "dashed",
      LRT = "solid",
      Baseline = "dotdash"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      glmm_no_rr = "#1B9E77",
      glmm_rr = "#D95F02",
      RaosQ = "#7570B3",
      `Randomized RaosQ` = "#E7298A"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = "log2",
    breaks = x_breaks,
    labels = x_breaks
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  
  labs(
    x = if (
      x_var == "r"
    ) {
      "Sample size (log2 scale)"
    } else {
      "Number of species (log2 scale)"
    },
    y = NULL,
    colour = "Model",
    linetype = "Test"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(
      angle = 0,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )
return(fig)
}
############################################################
## Locate output files
############################################################

files <- list.files(
  here("output", "Phy_fam_binomial_test_Both_axis_method_Method3_Eigen_3_Absence_TRUE_p_5"),
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

files_muMean <- list.files(
  here("output", "Phy_fam_binomial_test_Both_axis_method_Method3_Eigen_3_Absence_TRUE_p_5_muMean"),
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

files_muRef <- list.files(
  here("output", "Phy_fam_binomial_test_Both_axis_method_Method3_Eigen_3_Absence_TRUE_p_5_muRef"),
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Number of files found:", length(files), "\n")

if(length(files) == 0){
  stop("No .rds files found in output/")
}

############################################################
## Read all result files
############################################################

res_all <- purrr::map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  
  x <- readRDS(f)
  
  # Rename old column to the new name
  if ("p_values" %in% names(x)) {
    x <- dplyr::rename(x, pvalue = p_values)
  }
  
  x
})

res_all_muMean <- purrr::map_dfr(files_muMean, function(f) {
  
  x <- readRDS(f)
  
  # Rename old column to the new name
  if ("p_values" %in% names(x)) {
    x <- dplyr::rename(x, pvalue = p_values)
  }
  
  x
})
res_all_muRef <- purrr::map_dfr(files_muRef, function(f) {
  
  x <- readRDS(f)
  
  # Rename old column to the new name
  if ("p_values" %in% names(x)) {
    x <- dplyr::rename(x, pvalue = p_values)
  }
  
  x
})
```
## summarize the Simulation Results based on mu Ref
```{r}
res_summary_muRef <- res_all_muRef %>%
  group_by(
    family,
    p,
    r,
    model,
    test,
    Eigen,
    com,
    method,
    axis_method) %>%
      summarise(
        power = mean (pvalue < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_jobs = n(),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
  PanelPlot (x_var = "r",
           q_fixed = 5,
           eigen_target = 3,
           axis_method_label = "Method3",
           levels_p <- c(5),
           levels_r <- c(4, 8, 16, 32, 64),
           res_summary = res_summary_muRef) 
```

## Summarize the Simulation Results

```{r cars}
res_summary <- res_all %>%
  group_by(
    family,
    p,
    r,
    model,
    test,
    Eigen,
    com,
    method,
    axis_method
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    power = mean(pvalue < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
    #alt_warning_ratio = mean(alt_warning_msgs != "None", na.rm = TRUE),

    #pvalue_failure_ratio = mean(status != "Success"),
    n_jobs = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
PanelPlot (x_var = "r",
           q_fixed = 5,
           eigen_target = 3,
           axis_method_label = "Method3",
           levels_p <- c(5),
           levels_r <- c(4, 8, 16, 32, 64))
boxplot(unique(res_all$eta_bar))
```


## Including Power and Type I Error Plots (Parameters from the model)

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# ############################################################
# ### Power plot
# ############################################################
# Plot settings




fig
```

Conclusions:
(1) We still have the expected power performance and type I error of model glmm_rr when there are totally absent species.

(2) Model glmm_rr is unstable at small sample sizes, whereas model glmm_no_rr is stable. This illustrates that we lack of evidence to account for species correlation in presence/absence data.

(3) The chosen effect size $\beta = \log(4)$ is relatively small, which causes that the general power is relatively lower at the simulated sample sizes. 


## Model Convergence Summary
```{r}
warning_summary <- res_all %>%
  group_by(p, r, axis_method, model, Eigen, test, com, alt_warning_msgs) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(p, r, axis_method, model, Eigen, test, com, desc(n))
warning_target <- warning_summary %>% 
  dplyr::filter(
    p == 80,
    model == 'glmm_rr',
    test == 'LRT',
    com == 2
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    p, r, alt_warning_msgs, n
  )
print(warning_target, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```
